description: Single-point self-consistent field (SCF) calculation to obtain ground-state energy and charge density
use_cases: initial step before band structure or DOS

ENCUT.rule: 1.3 * max(ENMAX from POTCAR), or use PREC to set automatically

kpoints.guideline: k_i ~ 30/a_i for metals, 20/a_i for insulators (a_i in Angstrom)
kpoints.note: Always converge k-mesh for production calculations

poscar.note: Must be provided or generated from structure database

potcar.rule: Use recommended potentials. _pv or _sv for transition metals. Standard for main group. _GW for GW/BSE workflows.
